name: Mai'ah
summary: At the Valley of Trials in Durotar, Mai'ah trains young Darkspear trolls in magic. She guides new spellcasters as they begin their path among the Horde.

sections.title: Arcane Mentor of the Den
sections.body: Young Darkspear trolls come to Mai'ah in the Valley of Trials to learn magic. Orcs favor the elements or the warrior's path, but trolls have a rare gift for arcane study. Candidates bring glyphic inscriptions, and Mai'ah teaches them to shape raw power into controlled incantations. That control matters in Durotar, where danger waits beyond the den.

faq.answer: Mai'ah trains Darkspear troll mages in the Valley of Trials in Durotar. She gives new spellcasters their first guidance and instruction before they travel into the wider lands of the Horde.

faq.q: Why is there a troll mage trainer in an orc starting area?
faq.answer: Young Darkspear trolls take their coming-of-age trials alongside orc youths after fleeing their sinking island home and settling in Durotar with Thrall's orcs. Orc culture largely shuns arcane magic because of past demon corruption, so troll mages such as Mai'ah guide their own kind.

faq.q: What role does she play in training new mages?
faq.answer: New troll mages bring Mai'ah written instructions, such as glyphic parchments, and she begins their formal training. She teaches the fundamentals of spellcasting so they can defend the Valley of Trials from local beasts and rogue Burning Blade infiltrators.

angles.text: As a Darkspear spellcaster, you begin your magical journey with Mai'ah. She teaches the discipline to weave fire, frost, and arcane energy beneath Durotar's harsh sun.
As a Darkspear youth, you can find cultural mentorship in the Valley of Trials from Mai'ah, who teaches an art rarely practiced by your orcish allies.
